page.meta_description: Forgotten Playland is a multiplayer party game with plushie mini-games, board-game chaos, and customization. Check release details and Steam shutdown info.
page.tagline: Plushie party chaos in an abandoned attic, with board-game battles, mini-games, and 32-player lobby mayhem.
overview: Forgotten Playland is a multiplayer party game set in an abandoned attic, where customizable plush characters called PlushKyns compete in mini-games and board-game-style matches. Gameplay videos show a social hub, a customization station, and a party games chest that launches rounds.

The Party Edition trailer highlights 20+ mini-games, a shorter Casual Game mode, and Board Game Mode. It says players can play solo, locally, or online with up to four players, with 32-player lobbies for larger chaos.

Earlier 2025 gameplay videos show Forgotten Playland available on the Epic Games Store. The official Forgotten Playland: Party Edition release trailer, published July 23, 2026, links to Steam and says the game releases July 30, 2026. The provided sources do not mention a Steam server shutdown.

how_to_play: Start in the Social Hub, the attic gathering area and starting point for play.
Customize your PlushKyn at the Customization Station, including skin, head, eyes, neck, arms, and legs.
Group up with friends or other players, then vote for the next mini-game from three choices or pick Select Random.
Play party rounds such as arena survival, block maze, rhythm stage, drawing maze, target track, and slot-car racing.
In Board Game Mode, hit floating red dice to roll, move across colored spaces, and deal with springboards, caterpillars, and teleporters.
Earn EXP and Fluffy after matches to level up and unlock items.
Use quick-chat and sticker wheels to communicate in the hub.

controls.input: WASD / Arrow keys / Left Stick / D-Pad
controls.action: Move in games such as Busy Board, Snuggle Standstill, and Fowl Fetch
Shoot or launch in Target Tumble
Pick up and deliver in Fowl Fetch

tips: In Busy Board, watch the highlighted hazard symbol and step off matching tiles before they activate.
In Snuggle Standstill, stop moving as soon as the chest opens; moving triggers elimination.
In Target Tumble, line up your arc before firing; each knocked-down can is one point, and the first to 10 wins.
In Fowl Fetch, grab chickens from the center and carry them to your color-coded nest; first to 5 wins.
In Board Game Mode, use springboards and teleporters, and watch for giant caterpillars blocking the board.
Use the quick-chat wheel to coordinate mode choices and group up in the Social Hub.

faq.q: Is there a Forgotten Playland Steam server shutdown?
faq.a: The provided sources do not mention a Steam server shutdown. The official Party Edition trailer links to Steam and lists a July 30, 2026 release, while earlier 2025 videos show the game on the Epic Games Store.

faq.q: When does Forgotten Playland: Party Edition release?
faq.a: The official release trailer says Forgotten Playland: Party Edition releases July 30, 2026.

faq.q: What platforms is Forgotten Playland on?
faq.a: Earlier gameplay videos point to the Epic Games Store, and the official Party Edition trailer includes a Steam link.

faq.q: How many players can play Forgotten Playland?
faq.a: The Party Edition trailer says solo, local, or online with up to 4 players, plus 32-player lobbies.
A March 2025 gameplay description lists it as free on the Epic Games Store. Check the current store listing for pricing.
It is a multiplayer party game in an abandoned attic, featuring customizable PlushKyns, mini-games, and a board-game mode.
